You must apply to be considered for the Red Seal Completion Bonus.

Apply online

For a faster application process, we recommend applying online.

Before you begin, review the Prepare to apply section.

The online application takes about 15 minutes to complete.

Apply and Submit documents

Application confirmations

When you apply, we'll ask for your email address. When you provide one, we will send confirmation that we received:

  • your application
  • your supporting documents

We may also send you an email to provide you with information or ask you to call us if we can't reach you by phone.

Please note that will not ask you to provide personal or financial information by email.

Other ways to apply

If you cannot apply online, contact the Red Seal Completion Bonus call centre to request a paper application form.

  • Complete and sign the paper application form in ink
  • Mail the application with copies of your supporting documents or drop it off at a Service Canada Centre near you
